There’s nothing wrong with Arrayable/ArrayableTrait. The problem is that ArrayHelper::toArray() isn't telling Arrayable::toArray() whether or not it should be recursive.
it's current recursice, i posted link https://github.com/brandonkelly/yii2/blob/ef8925618f316d7324cd7898f006163550b8e2af/framework/helpers/BaseArrayHelper.php#L96

You’ve posted that link 4 times now, but I keep saying that it's not the problem! Have you tried running my test? It clearly demonstrates that `$recursive = false` is **not** being respected, due to the `$object->toArray();` call on [line 88](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/befd42f46ad324e003be30fa2e5cbfd760d05bad/framework/helpers/BaseArrayHelper.php#L88).
if recursive is false, why we need run toArray with `recursive= false`?

Because Arrayable requires the toArray() to specify a $recursive argument, set to `true` by default (https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/base/Arrayable.php#L89).

If ArrayHelper::toArray()’s $recursive value isn’t passed to Arrayable::toArray(), then Arrayable::toArray() will recursively turn the object into an array, regardless of what you told ArrayHelper::toArray() to do.

`ArrayHelper::toArray($model, [], false);`
why inner `toArray` we should run toArray($model, [], false) ?
Because you told ArrayHelper::toArray() you don’t want it to convert the object to an array recursively. It doesn’t matter why - that’s up to the application logic to decide.
Looks like this wasn’t fixed in Yii 2.0.4. Any word? Seems like a pretty straightforward bug to me. @qiangxue
